title: Boundaries of Groups and Kleinian Groups — Problem 67
exact_target: Does every hyperbolic subgroup of a hyperbolic group admit a continuous map between their boundaries that respects the subgroup action, including when the subgroup is not quasiconvex?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 6200067 (AMR-061-0067). CC BY 4.0.
